author: Onlythetruth1
quote: The greatest game of all time is back and it looks absolutely gorgeous. Ocarina of Time for the Switch 2 belongs in the league of legendary games along with the original version of the game. The characters feel real and the voice acting is superb. Nintendo has done it again and they’ve shown the world how to make a proper remake.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Onlythetruth1

game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Onlythetruth1
quote: I've been playing the GTA series since GTA II. GTA VI has ZERO innovation, and on top of that, many missions and tasks are boring. The story is not interesting and the characters don’t feel real. This game is a huge disappointment.
